data.comparison: Round-4 anchors are merged under the frozen 0.02 A band. Pool condition minimum is [3,7,5,5] at 0.793887 A, so the band edge is 0.813887 A; every tested schedule, including all round-4 anchors, is inside the band. The current in-band functional leader is [7,5,5,0] at gap 3.625909 and condition 0.796318 A, replacing [7,5,5,1] at 3.625973. The G1/G2/G3 round-4 anchors were high-side adverse (i0=9) and trail badly; G4 is the only anchor on the leader itself. Final ranking by predicted terminal gap versus the leader, not by risk labels or a fabricated tie threshold: G4:H1 is best because it is the direct leader with the measured interval1 low reversal; G2:H1 is second as i0 repair plus interval1 low; G1:H1 is third as the same transfer with i2=7/i3=3; G2:H2 is fourth as the interval1 -1 bracket that can still beat the leader if the transfer is linear. G4:H2 is fifth, a small independent interval2-low branch on the leader; G1:H2, G3:H2, and G3:H1 are lower because their predicted terminal gaps are near or above the leader and depend on weaker transfer/background assumptions. All forecasts remain in band; condition is nonbinding. Best remains below the teacher, so the Best bonus does not displace functional ranking.
data.failure_directions: If interval1 low does not transfer to i0=7 backgrounds, G4:H1 may only match the leader and G2:H1/G1:H1/G2:H2 will trail; revise the interval1 low-transfer belief, not interval1 globally. If G4:H1 improves but G2:H1 and G1:H1 do not, interval1 low is background-specific. If G2:H1 improves more than G2:H2, the interval1 low slope is closer to the full -2 reversal; if G2:H2 is flat while G2:H1 improves, overshoot or nonlinearity is indicated. If G4:H2 is flat/adverse, interval2 remains near-null at this scale and background; this does not close interval2. If any selected arm leaves the 0.813887 A band or fails to beat 3.625909 under the frozen comparison, reject that tested schedule and retain the cached leader; a forecast miss alone does not become a noise floor or a closure of the interval. No high-side interval0 continuation is selected because 7->9 was adverse on tested backgrounds, but this is not proof that every untested interval0 interior is infeasible.

learning_update.observed_result: Leader margin is 0.001583 A; another interval-3 2-tick step at about +0.00064 A would leave about 0.00094 A, and adding interval 2 at +0.00025 A would leave about 0.00069 A. On this background Best rose slightly, 7.218387 -> 7.218528, rather than dropping.
learning_update.revision: The earlier large Best drop did not reproduce, so Best movement from interval 3 is idiosyncratic and stays a third-priority cost; the real limit on further interval-3 lowering is the thin condition headroom, not Best. Compensation remains unjustified because no observed arm buys function at a condition cost near the band edge.
learning_update.next_action: Keep forecasts condition-aware: any further down-side composition should be reported against the 1.922172 A band top as well as the gap, and any Best loss is disclosed as a secondary tradeoff rather than a veto.
learning_update.applicability: This teacher, fixed R0, the current in-band leaders and the frozen band-plus-gap rule.
learning_update.alternative_explanation: Best could be a single candidate's terminal basin sensitivity that happens to move in either direction on different backgrounds, which would keep Best uninformative rather than window-specific.

learning_update.prior_judgment: Interval 2 had exactly one read (5->3: +0.000245 A / -5.4369e-5 pIC50) with its second step and up side unmeasured, and interval 1 was inert in both directions at 2-tick scale across three backgrounds.
learning_update.intervention: Reviewed the execution history for any new interval-2 or interval-1 contrast after round 4 and checked which legal branches remain at their bounds.
learning_update.observed_result: No new interval-2 or interval-1 data this round. Interval-1 5->3 remains +0.000614 A / -2.8e-5 pIC50, its up side -0.000427 A / +0.000274, and the 3->5 anchor pair -1.7e-5 A / -5.74e-5. Interval 2 is at 3 in the leader and its lower bound is 1, so one legal 2-tick step remains.
learning_update.revision: Interval 2 remains the least-measured legal lever and its second step is archived only inside the joint H2, which pairs with H1 to conditionally isolate interval-2 3->1 on the interval-3=1 background; interval 1 stays deprioritised, not closed.
learning_update.next_action: If sampling were reopened, take the single-interval interval-2 read before any further interval-1 slot; with budget exhausted, record both windows as amplitude-insensitive-or-untested rather than resolved.
learning_update.applicability: This teacher, fixed R0, backgrounds [1,.,3,3], [1,.,3,5] and [1,.,5,5]; other amplitudes and new populations untested.
learning_update.alternative_explanation: Interval 2 may be washed out by 24 later guided steps plus 10 unguided terminal steps, in which case a null would reflect washout rather than insensitivity of steps 51-75.

learning_update.prior_judgment: The final round was expected to add one more in-band functional challenger and to leave a small set of unresolved window questions to carry forward.
learning_update.intervention: Read search_budget and the incumbent-versus-latest paired comparison, and checked the final phase before selecting the two archived arrays.
learning_update.observed_result: consumed_fraction 1.0, completed_rounds 5 of 5, remaining_sampling_rounds 0, decision_phase review_only, so the proposals are archived without execution. The selected incumbent population has mean affinity 4.229921, best 7.224056, gap 3.182283, and beats the leader on 88% of the 25 common valid candidates with paired mean +0.018649 pIC50 (median +0.001476, q90 +0.020618, min -0.000223, max +0.262798).
learning_update.revision: The incumbent is selected output, not a shared schedule or generation parent, so it is not ranked against the schedules; its advantage shows that per-candidate selection under the fixed restart contributes more than the amplitude changes under test, and the leader stays the shared-schedule leader. Budget exhaustion stops sampling, it does not establish infeasibility of any window.
learning_update.next_action: Archive H1 [1,3,3,1] and H2 [1,3,1,1] and report the unresolved branches: the interval-3 second step and lower bound, the interval-2 second step and its composition with interval 3, the never-supplied interval-0 up side or compensation contrast, the background-conditional interval-3 functional gain, and the fact that no candidate reaches teacher 7.412205 with only 2-3 of 25 chemically mappable.
learning_update.applicability: This teacher, this fixed restart, the eighteen measured shared schedules and the selected incumbent population.
learning_update.alternative_explanation: The incumbent's edge could be a fixed-population selection effect that vanishes on a new start population; that is a generalisation limit and does not convert any measured schedule difference into a tie.

data.parent_policy: Every proposal restarts the same new R0 before update 10. Incumbent is output only.
